jobs.requirement_text: Runtime-verify the Mercury dime test advertisement Collect flow: Collect becomes Collected, the Mercury card appears in the visible Shop cart, the cart opens, and the existing 0.1 StarCoin collect-credit path fires exactly once.
acceptance_checks: Mercury dime test sale renders on the deployed Infinity Phi page.
Tapping Collect changes the control to Collected.
The Shop cart opens from the collect action.
The visible cart contains the Mercury dime card with price label 100 Quants.
One collect action emits/records exactly one 0.1 StarCoin credit through the existing collect-credit path.
Reload behavior does not falsely show Collected unless the item remains available from the current cart persistence layer.
No Quant payment is reported or implied by this test collect flow.

deployment status for repair commit if changed
after runtime evidence on deployed page
constraints: Do not create or simulate a real Quant transfer.
Do not store shipping information in Quant metadata, URLs, public ledgers, or transferable event payloads.
Preserve the explicit test-listing and no-Quant-transfer language.

jobs.requirement_text: Build the server-backed 100-Quant marketplace settlement and private order/fulfillment flow only after the wallet transfer and order authority are identified and separately verified.
acceptance_checks: Authoritative server wallet verifies a 100-Quant transfer before an order is marked paid.
Payment transaction ID is idempotently bound to one order.
Private shipping data is stored only in the authorized private order store.
Seller receives a durable sale/ship-item event without exposing buyer private data publicly.
Buyer can read fulfillment status and tracking when supplied.
Transferable Quant metadata contains no shipping address, payment credentials, or private customer fields.
constraints: Do not mark paid from a browser-only event.
Do not expose private customer data to transferable Quant metadata.
Do not perform a real-value transfer during unattended verification.
